vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.22.0

The skill bundle provides a structured framework for organizing Obsidian notes using a Knowledge Graph (KG) methodology. It defines specific workflows for note categorization, metadata management (YAML frontmatter), and relationship building between files. While the instructions direct the agent to perform file operations (read/write/search) and limited network tasks (using `curl -I` to validate image links and performing web searches for content enrichment), these actions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of note organization. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or harmful prompt injection was found across the SKILL.md or reference files.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only Obsidian note-organizing skill, but it tells the agent to make broad, mandatory changes across a note vault and pull in web content without strong approval or rollback limits.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: organize Obsidian notes using a knowledge-graph method. The requested capabilities are also substantial: reading notes, searching the vault, creating relationship notes, modifying metadata, removing direct links, and enriching notes from the web.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Normal workflows are not just advisory; they repeatedly say steps are mandatory and can create, modify, or delete files. Only the explicit check mode is clearly read-only.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, no executable code, no required binaries, no declared credentials, and the static scan had no code to analyze.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill can expand from one requested note to many related notes, pairwise relationship scans, web searches, and remote image embedding, without clear path bounds, exclusions, backups, or per-change approval.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background process or credential use is shown, but the skill writes persistent Obsidian content that may shape future agent behavior and user knowledge.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting an agent reorganize your Obsidian vault. Use the read-only check workflow first, keep backups or version control, restrict runs to specific notes or folders, require approval for deletes/renames/bulk relationship creation, and review any web-sourced text or image links before keeping them.

evidence.explanation: The skill tells the user's agent to apply this rule set automatically for broad Obsidian-note contexts, not only when the user explicitly runs a kg command.
evidence.snippet: 打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill。 ... 路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the skill only for deliberate note-organization tasks, and tell the agent not to auto-apply it when merely opening or discussing notes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may start applying KG reorganization rules during ordinary note work, which could be surprising if the user only wanted to view or lightly edit a note.

evidence.explanation: The normal workflow authorizes persistent file changes, new files, moving content, and deletion of links or redundant content, while presenting the steps as mandatory and not requiring per-change confirmation.
evidence.snippet: 整个操作按以下顺序执行，每步不可跳过 ... 无关内容分离 ... 已有更完整→删；无主体→新建→移入 ... 直链去前补关系：先确保关系笔记已建好，再从主体笔记删除直链。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Run the read-only `kg 检查` mode first, keep vault backups or version control, and require explicit approval before renames, deletions, bulk edits, or new relationship files are written.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A single command could modify the user's Obsidian vault in ways that are hard to review or undo, including deleting or moving content.

evidence.explanation: The skill can propagate one classification or search mistake into many new relationship notes and follow-up checks across multiple subjects.
evidence.snippet: 搜到的每个有效关联必须在步骤⑤建关系，不可跳过。 ... 读写拆分即关联 ... 对一批新主体，两两检查是否应有关系线

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit each run to a small set of notes, review proposed relationships before writing them, and cap automatic pairwise scans or bulk relationship creation.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: An incorrect interpretation of one note could spread into many files, creating noisy or wrong knowledge-graph links throughout the vault.

evidence.explanation: The skill intentionally adds web-sourced information and remote image URLs into persistent notes, which future users or agents may later treat as trusted context.
evidence.snippet: `kg 完善 "笔记名.md"` ... 搜索网络补充更新 → 标注信息来源 ... 主动搜索网络嵌入 ... 格式：`![描述](url)`

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review all web-sourced additions, prefer reputable sources, avoid using web enrichment on sensitive private notes, and consider storing vetted images locally instead of embedding arbitrary remote URLs.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Incorrect web results, untrusted image URLs, or low-quality sources could become part of the user's long-term note base.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to run a shell/network command against image URLs found in notes, even though no required binary is declared.
evidence.snippet: 疑似失效的网络图片 → `curl -I` 检查状态码

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only check http/https URLs, quote or safely pass URL arguments, avoid shell interpolation, and ask before contacting unfamiliar domains.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If run unsafely, URL checks could contact untrusted hosts or mishandle unusual URLs from note content.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The main risk is broad mandatory note-vault mutation and cascading relationship creation, with a smaller note about shell-based URL checking.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, OAuth, account access, or privileged service permissions are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill reads and searches local notes and can persist web-sourced content and remote image links, but no credential handling or explicit exfiltration endpoint is shown.
